# Tool Reference

<!-- Auto-generated by `scripts/gen_tool_docs.py` — do not edit by hand, your changes will be overwritten on the next commit. -->

154 tools. All tool names are lowercase with underscores — use these exact strings with `ENABLED_TOOLS` or `--include-tools`. The Groups column names the [tool groups](configuration.md#tool-groups) that load each tool, and `all` loads every one.

## Sheets — data

| Tool | Description | Key parameters | Groups |
|---|---|---|---|
| `get_sheet_data` | Get data from a specific sheet in a Google Spreadsheet: its values, as displayed or unformatted, or its formulas. | `spreadsheet_id`, `sheet`, `range?`, `include_grid_data?`, `local_path?`, `value_render?` | `sheets`, `default` |
| `get_sheet_formulas` | Deprecated: use `get_sheet_data` with `value_render='formula'` instead. Removed in the next feature release. | `spreadsheet_id`, `sheet`, `range?` | `sheets` |
| `get_multiple_sheet_data` | Get data from multiple specific ranges in Google Spreadsheets. | `queries`, `local_path?` | `sheets` |
| `get_multiple_spreadsheet_summary` | Get a summary of multiple Google Spreadsheets, including sheet names, headers, and the first few rows of data for each sheet. | `spreadsheet_ids`, `rows_to_fetch?`, `local_path?` | `sheets` |
| `find_in_spreadsheet` | Find cells containing a specific value in a Google Spreadsheet. | `spreadsheet_id`, `query`, `sheet?`, `case_sensitive?`, `max_results?`, `local_path?` | `sheets`, `default` |
| `clear_values` | Clear cell content in a range without touching formatting. | `spreadsheet_id`, `sheet`, `range?` | `sheets` |
| `update_cells` | Update cells in a Google Spreadsheet. | `spreadsheet_id`, `sheet`, `range`, `data` | `sheets`, `default` |
| `batch_update_cells` | Batch update multiple ranges in a Google Spreadsheet. | `spreadsheet_id`, `sheet`, `ranges` | `sheets` |
| `batch_update` | Execute a batch update on a Google Spreadsheet using the full batchUpdate endpoint. This provides access to all batchUpdate operations including adding sheets, updating properties, inserting/deleting dimensions, formatting, and more. | `spreadsheet_id`, `requests` | `sheets`, `default` |

`batch_update` is the escape hatch for anything not covered by a named tool (formatting, conditional formatting, dimension properties, etc.).

## Spreadsheets (Drive-level)

| Tool | Description | Key parameters | Groups |
|---|---|---|---|
| `create_spreadsheet` | Create a new Google Spreadsheet. | `title`, `folder_id?` | `drive`, `sheets`, `default` |
| `import_csv_to_sheet` | Create a new Google Spreadsheet populated from a local CSV file. Not available when the server runs with LOCAL_FILE_ACCESS=off. | `local_path`, `title`, `folder_id?`, `sheet_name?` | `drive`, `sheets`, `local-files` |
| `list_spreadsheets` | Deprecated: use `search_files` (add `folder_id` for one folder) with `mime_type='application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet'` and this tool's default `max_results=100` instead. Removed in the next feature release. | `folder_id?`, `max_results?` | `drive`, `sheets` |
| `search_spreadsheets` | Deprecated: use `search_files` with `mime_type='application/vnd.google-apps.spreadsheet'` instead. Removed in the next feature release. | `query`, `max_results?` | `drive`, `sheets` |

`create_spreadsheet` cannot create files in a personal Drive when using service account auth — use OAuth or a Shared Drive.

Removed in the next feature release. | `parent_folder_id?`, `max_results?` | `drive` |

| `rename_file` | Rename a file or folder in Google Drive. | `file_id`, `new_name` | `drive`, `default` |

| `list_recent_files` | Deprecated: use `search_files` (newest first by default; its files carry `mimeType`, not `mime_type`) with `modified_within_days` instead. Removed in the next feature release. | `max_results?`, `days?`, `mime_type?` | `drive` |
| `get_storage_quota` | Get Drive storage usage and limits for the authenticated account. | — | `drive` |

Raises an API error (does not silently no-op) if the file was permanently deleted or otherwise no longer exists — permanent deletion can't be recovered from. | `file_id` | `drive` |

| `upload_file` | Upload a text file to Google Drive, optionally converting it to a Google Doc. | `name`, `content`, `source_format?`, `folder_id?`, `convert_to_doc?`, `auto_downscale?` | `drive`, `default` |
| `upload_local_file` | Upload a file from the local filesystem to a Google Drive folder. Handles binary and text files (images, PDFs, DOCX, XLSX, scripts, etc.). | `sync_folder` | Sync files between a Google Drive folder and a local directory. Not available when the server runs with LOCAL_FILE_ACCESS=off. | `folder_id`, `local_path`, `direction?`, `export_format?`, `convert_markdown?`, `use_checksum?`, `skip_system_files?`, `dry_run?`, `recursive?`, `result_local_path?`, `resolve?` | `drive`, `local-files` |

## Drive — sharing

| Tool | Description | Key parameters | Groups |
|---|---|---|---|
| `share_spreadsheet` | Deprecated: use `share_file` with each recipient as `{'type': 'user', 'email_address': ..., 'role': ...}`, setting this tool's default `'role': 'writer'` explicitly instead. Removed in the next feature release. | `spreadsheet_id`, `recipients`, `send_notification?` | `drive`, `sheets` |
| `list_permissions` | List all permissions on a file or folder in Google Drive. | `file_id` | `drive` |
| `update_permission` | Change the role on an existing permission for a file or folder. | `file_id`, `permission_id`, `role` | `drive` |
| `remove_permission` | Revoke a permission on a file or folder. | `file_id`, `permission_id` | `drive` |
| `transfer_ownership` | Transfer ownership of a file or folder to another user. | `file_id`, `new_owner_email`, `send_notification?` | `drive` |
| `share_file` | Share any file or folder with one or more principals. | `file_id`, `permissions`, `send_notification?` | `drive`, `default` |

`share_file`'s `permissions` is a list of `{type, role, ...}` objects — `type` is `user`, `group`, `domain`, or `anyone`; `user`/`group` also need `email_address`, `domain` needs `domain`. Valid roles: `reader`, `commenter`, `writer`; a `role` left out means `reader`.

`share_spreadsheet` is deprecated: its `recipients` entry `{email_address, role}` is `share_file`'s `{type: 'user', email_address, role}`, except that a `role` left out means `writer`. Valid roles: `reader`, `commenter`, `writer`.

## Drive — activity

| Tool | Description | Key parameters | Groups |
|---|---|---|---|
| `list_file_activity` | Return the activity timeline for a Google Drive file. | `file_id`, `page_size?`, `page_token?` | `drive` |

Requires the `drive.activity.readonly` scope; uses the Drive Activity API v2.

## Drive — comments

| Tool | Description | Key parameters | Groups |
|---|---|---|---|
| `list_file_comments` | List the comments (and their replies) on a Drive file: a Google Doc, Sheet, or Slides deck, or any other file Drive supports comments on. | `file_id?`, `page_size?`, `page_token?`, `include_deleted?`, `doc_id?` | `drive`, `comments` |
| `add_file_comment` | Add a comment to a Drive file: a Google Doc, Sheet, or Slides deck, or any other file Drive supports comments on. | `file_id?`, `content`, `quoted_text?`, `anchor?`, `doc_id?` | `drive`, `comments` |
| `reply_to_comment` | Reply to a comment on a Drive file, and optionally resolve or reopen it. Resolving and reopening are replies with an action, so they go through this tool too. | `file_id`, `comment_id`, `content?`, `action?` | `drive`, `comments` |
| `get_file_comment` | Get one comment on a Drive file, with every reply on it. | `file_id`, `comment_id`, `include_deleted?` | `drive`, `comments` |
| `update_comment` | Replace the text of a comment on a Drive file, or of one reply to it. | `file_id`, `comment_id`, `content`, `reply_id?` | `drive`, `comments` |
| `delete_comment` | Delete a comment on a Drive file, with its replies, or one reply to it. | `file_id`, `comment_id`, `reply_id?` | `drive`, `comments` |
| `resolve_doc_comment` | Deprecated: use `reply_to_comment` with `action='resolve'` instead. Removed in the next feature release. | `doc_id`, `comment_id`, `reply_content?` | `drive`, `comments` |

Comments on any Drive file that takes them: Docs, Sheets, Slides and other files, through the Drive `comments`/`replies` resource. Resolving and reopening a comment are replies with an `action`, so `reply_to_comment` does both.

| `create_bookmark` | Deprecated: use `create_named_range` with `start_index` set to `index` and `end_index` omitted instead. Removed in the next feature release. | `doc_id`, `name`, `index` | `docs` |
| `get_doc_as_markdown` | Export a Google Doc's content as GitHub-flavored Markdown. | `doc_id`, `include_comments?`, `local_path?` | `docs`, `default` |

`write_doc_content` and `create_doc` accept either HTML or Markdown (`content_format='markdown'`) and convert it to Docs API requests via the HTML→AST→emitter pipeline — Markdown is converted to HTML first. See [Docs AST Pipeline](design/docs-ast-pipeline.md) for the design and [Markdown Support](design/markdown-support.md) for the full Markdown→Docs mapping table.

`create_doc` cannot create files in a personal Drive when using service account auth — see [Authentication](auth.md#method-a-service-account-recommended-for-servers).

## Calendar

| Tool | Description | Key parameters | Groups |
|---|---|---|---|
| `list_calendars` | List all calendars accessible to the authenticated user. | — | `calendar`, `default` |
| `get_calendar` | Fetch metadata for a single calendar. | `calendar_id` | `calendar` |
| `create_calendar` | Create a new secondary calendar owned by the authenticated user. | `summary`, `description?`, `timezone?` | `calendar` |
| `update_calendar` | Update fields on an existing calendar using patch semantics. Only the fields you provide are changed; omitted fields are left as-is. | `calendar_id`, `summary?`, `description?`, `timezone?`, `color_id?` | `calendar` |
| `delete_calendar` | Permanently delete a calendar. For calendars you own, this deletes the calendar entirely for all users it is shared with — use with caution. To only stop seeing a calendar in your own list, use remove_calendar_from_list instead. | `calendar_id` | `calendar` |
| `add_calendar_to_list` | Subscribe the authenticated user (or service account) to a calendar, adding it to their calendar list so it appears in list_calendars. | `calendar_id`, `color_id?` | `calendar` |
| `remove_calendar_from_list` | Unsubscribe from a calendar, removing it from the authenticated user's calendar list. The calendar itself is not deleted and is unaffected for any other user it's shared with — use delete_calendar to permanently delete a calendar you own. | `calendar_id` | `calendar` |
| `list_calendar_acl` | List the access control rules (sharing entries) on a calendar. Every page is fetched (250 rules each), up to a 100-page safety bound. | `calendar_id` | `calendar` |
| `add_calendar_acl` | Grant access to a calendar by adding an access control rule. | `calendar_id`, `role`, `scope_type?`, `scope_value?`, `send_notifications?` | `calendar` |
| `remove_calendar_acl` | Revoke an access control rule from a calendar. | `calendar_id`, `rule_id` | `calendar` |
| `list_events` | List events in a calendar. | `calendar_id`, `time_min?`, `time_max?`, `query?`, `max_results?`, `expand_recurring?` | `calendar`, `default` |
| `get_event` | Fetch a single event by calendar ID and event ID. | `calendar_id`, `event_id` | `calendar`, `default` |
| `create_event` | Create a new event in a calendar. | `calendar_id`, `summary`, `start`, `end`, `description?`, `location?`, `attendees?`, `timezone?`, `recurrence?` | `calendar`, `default` |
| `update_event` | Update fields on an existing event using a partial update (patch semantics). Only the fields you provide are changed; omitted fields are left as-is. | `calendar_id`, `event_id`, `summary?`, `start?`, `end?`, `description?`, `location?`, `attendees?`, `timezone?`, `recurrence?` | `calendar`, `default` |
| `delete_event` | Delete or cancel an event. | `calendar_id`, `event_id` | `calendar`, `default` |
| `find_free_slots` | Query busy times for a list of calendars and return free slots within the window. | `calendar_ids`, `time_min`, `time_max`, `timezone?` | `calendar`, `default` |
| `list_all_events` | List events across multiple calendars in one call, fanning out to each calendar in parallel instead of requiring one list_events call per calendar. At most LIST_ALL_EVENTS_MAX_CONCURRENCY (default 20) calendars are queried at once, shared across every concurrent list_all_events call on this server. | `time_min?`, `time_max?`, `query?`, `calendar_ids?`, `max_results_per_calendar?`, `expand_recurring?`, `group_by_calendar?` | `calendar` |

**Note:** when using service account auth, calendars must be explicitly shared with the service account. The service account must also subscribe to shared calendars via `calendarList().insert()` before they appear in `list_calendars`.

## Gmail

| Tool | Description | Key parameters | Groups |
|---|---|---|---|
| `list_messages` | List messages in the authenticated user's mailbox. | `query?`, `label_ids?`, `max_results?`, `page_token?`, `include_spam_trash?` | `gmail`, `default` |
| `get_message` | Fetch a single message by ID, including headers, body, and attachment metadata. | `message_id`, `local_path?`, `include_body?` | `gmail` |
| `list_threads` | List conversation threads in the authenticated user's mailbox. | `query?`, `label_ids?`, `max_results?`, `page_token?`, `include_spam_trash?` | `gmail` |
| `get_thread` | Fetch all messages in a conversation thread. | `thread_id`, `local_path?`, `include_body?` | `gmail`, `default` |
| `list_labels` | List all labels in the authenticated user's mailbox (system and user-defined). | — | `gmail`, `default` |
| `send_message` | Send a new email message, after the user confirms it (by default). | `to`, `subject`, `body`, `cc?`, `bcc?`, `body_html?`, `attachments?` | `gmail`, `default` |
| `create_draft` | Create a draft email without sending it. | `to`, `subject`, `body`, `cc?`, `bcc?`, `body_html?`, `attachments?` | `gmail`, `default` |
| `send_draft` | Send an existing draft by ID, after the user confirms it (by default). | `draft_id` | `gmail`, `default` |
| `list_drafts` | List drafts in the authenticated user's mailbox. | `query?`, `max_results?`, `page_token?`, `include_spam_trash?` | `gmail`, `default` |
| `get_draft` | Fetch a single draft by ID, including headers, body, and attachment metadata. | `draft_id`, `local_path?`, `include_body?` | `gmail` |
| `update_draft` | Replace a draft's content without sending it. The draft keeps its ID. | `draft_id`, `to`, `subject`, `body`, `cc?`, `bcc?`, `body_html?`, `attachments?`, `keep_attachments?` | `gmail` |
| `delete_draft` | Permanently delete a draft. Unlike trash_message, it can't be recovered. | `draft_id` | `gmail` |
| `reply_to_message` | Send a reply in an existing thread, after the user confirms it (by default). | `message_id`, `body`, `body_html?`, `reply_all?` | `gmail`, `default` |
| `modify_labels` | Add or remove labels on a message or an entire thread. | `add_label_ids?`, `remove_label_ids?`, `message_id?`, `thread_id?` | `gmail`, `default` |
| `trash_message` | Move a message to trash (recoverable). | `message_id` | `gmail` |

**Note:** Gmail tools require OAuth (personal mailbox) auth today. Service-account / domain-wide delegation is not wired yet (no delegated subject). Composites such as find-unanswered / send-reminders are out of scope — compose them from these primitives (see [decision-composite-tools](decisions/decision-composite-tools.md)).

## Cache

| Tool | Description | Key parameters | Groups |
|---|---|---|---|
| `get_cache_ttl` | Read the cache TTL currently in effect for this running process. | — | `cache` |
| `set_cache_ttl` | Change the cache time-to-live at runtime, without restarting the server. | `ttl_seconds` | `cache` |
| `refresh_cache` | Invalidate caches, forcing a fresh fetch on next use. | `spreadsheet_id?`, `doc_id?`, `folder_id?`, `calendar_id?` | `cache` |

Omit all parameters to flush the entire cache. See [Configuration](configuration.md#caching) for TTL and path settings.

## MCP resources

Two resources are available (read-only, not tools):

| Resource | Description |
|---|---|
| `server://auth-status` | Active auth method and Drive capability limits |
| `spreadsheet://{spreadsheet_id}/info` | Sheet list and grid properties for a spreadsheet |
